title: FBI
description:
S02 E19 — Emotional Rescue
The team investigates a drug deal gone bad after the body of a college student is found; Detective Hailey Upton temporarily joins the team and finds her investigative methods clash with the Bureau's more buttoned-up environment.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E01 — Never Trust a Stranger
The team welcomes a new member, Special Agent Tiffany Wallace, as they search for killers who orchestrated a mass shooting at a media company; OA's personal connection with the case threatens to cloud his judgment.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E02 — Unreasonable Doubt
The team races to stop an active serial killer after three women are found weighted down at the bottom of a lake; Jubal looks into an old closed case after there are multiple similarities to the recent victims.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E03 — Liar's Poker
When the leader of a drug cartel and one of the world's most wanted men is apprehended by the team, the entire FBI headquarters is put at risk when his henchmen unveil a plot to free him; Isobel must make a difficult decision.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E04 — Crazy Love
A shooting at a quinceañera leaves two dead, but the team believes they may not have been the intended targets; Maggie is conflicted as the team decides the best plan of action for using a witness to take down their suspect.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E05 — Clean Slate
The team searches for a young girl who was kidnapped from a cabin during a family vacation; Maggie questions her relationship with Nestor when she learns he hasn't been completely honest with her.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E06 — Uncovered
The team must infiltrate a drug trafficking gang after the robbery of a chemical plant leaves two customs agents dead; Nestor offers his help on the case, giving Maggie new insight into his character.

title: The Waterboy
description: Raised by his overprotective mother, Helen, Bobby Boucher Jr. is the water boy for a successful college football team coached by Red Beaulieu.

title: Central Intelligence
description: A lethal CIA agent (Dwayne Johnson) and his former classmate (Kevin Hart) encounter shootouts, espionage and double-crosses while trying to save the U.S. spy satellite system.

title: The House
description: Desperate for money, a couple and their neighbor start an underground casino in their quiet suburban neighborhood. As the money rolls in and the good times fly, they soon learn that they may have bitten off more than they can chew.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E01 — Little Egypt
After a bomb detonates at a restaurant in Queens, the case becomes personal for OA, who grew up eating there; OA goes undercover to prevent another incident.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E02 — The Lives of Others
After the son of a prominent blogger is kidnapped, the team must sweep through her two million followers to find the culprit; Kristen continues to adjust to life as a field agent with her new partner Stuart Scola.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E03 — American Idol
After a female presidential candidate, Valerie Caldwell, is targeted with a car bomb, OA and Maggie must find them before they strike again; the case leads them to wonder if she is being targeted for her political aspirations or something else.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E04 — An Imperfect Science
After a shooting at a nightclub, it appears that the FBI may have ignored previous threats from a local white supremacist group; Kristen wrestles with her commitment to the bureau and her responsibility to her community.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E07 — Discord
The team hunts a killer who is fatally shooting seemingly unrelated targets; new agent Tiffany Wallace experiences tension between her work as an FBI agent and the responsibility she feels to her community as a Black woman.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E08 — Walk the Line
After a bomb leaves three people dead, the team presses a reluctant informant to gather information from his close friends who are under suspicion; OA and his girlfriend clash over where the informant's rights lie.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E09 — Leverage
When a reporter is kidnapped and held without a ransom demand, the team must dig into her past relationships in order to pin down her assailant's motive; Isobel's relationship comes under fire when the case makes a connection to her boyfriend.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E10 — Checks and Balances
The team must track down two assailants who wear animal masks while committing armed robberies; Tiffany and Scola butt heads on whether to accept the local NYPD's offer to help in the investigation.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E11 — Brother's Keeper
After a man is killed by an explosive package shipped to his home, the team attempts to capture the sender and intercept his latest deadly parcel; Maggie struggles to trust her younger sister.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E12 — Fathers and Sons
The team rushes to track down two doctors abducted by a desperate father willing to do anything to save his son; Jubal's uncertainty in his family life affects his judgment during the hostage situation.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E13 — Short Squeeze
When the CEO of a major brokerage firm is killed while surrounded by protesters, the team looks into who had the most to lose from his company's perceived manipulations; Scola's previous Wall Street career and the reasons he left come to light.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E14 — Trigger Effect
While investigating a mass casualty incident at a New York City restaurant, the team scrambles to determine if it was racially motivated and if there was more than one gunman; Maggie starts to notice troubling behavior from her co-worker Elise.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E15 — Straight Flush
When five prominent men are gunned down at a trendy New York restaurant, the team's investigation brings them into contact with a lieutenant in Antonio Vargas' cartel, triggering a showdown between Isobel and Vargas.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E01 — All That Glitters
After a young woman is killed on her way home from a lavish yacht party, the team investigates who she was and how she came to be at the event.

title: Batman Begins
description: Following the death of his parents, young heir Bruce Wayne (Christian Bale) becomes a masked avenger who fights the forces of evil in Gotham City.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman must keep a balance between heroism and vigilantism to fight a criminal known as the Joker, who would plunge Gotham City into anarchy.

title: The Dark Knight Rises
description: Eight years after he took the blame for Harvey Dent's death and vanished into the night, Batman is forced out of his self-imposed exile by a cunning cat burglar and a merciless terrorist called Bane.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E05 — Crossroads
A loving husband and father of two is kidnapped after accidentally getting involved in illegal dealings far beyond what he imagined; Jubal must make a difficult decision regarding his family and their future.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E06 — Outsider
After a Wall Street investor is murdered, the team is led to an insider-trading ring that uses unconventional methods to gain information; OA struggles to maintain confidence in his budding relationship with Mona.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E07 — Undisclosed
When a board member of a soon-to-be-public medical tech company is murdered, the team tries to find out who had the most to gain from his death; OA is conflicted when pressure to help a family member is at odds with his commitment to tell the truth.

title: FBI
description:
S02 E08 — Codename: Ferdinand
A car crash results in the death of a photographer; Maggie sympathizes with his widow when she notices similarities with her own husband's death.

description:

America invades Iraq, and Saddam Hussein vanishes; CIA analyst John Nixon mobilizes a task force to find him; on the embattled streets of Baghdad, Captain Samir hunts door to door for High Value Target No. 1.

AEW honors Rebel in her fight against ALS; David Finlay faces Will Ospreay in a World Title Eliminator, Swerve Strickland & New Level defend Trios titles against Conglomeration, and the Young Bucks take on Fletcher & Jet in a Tables match.

The world's best dunkers compete in a professional league, with an expert panel of judges narrowing the field to one Dunkman World Champion and a $500,000 grand prize.
